figures.caption: Figure 5: Scenario with a time-invariant covariate, W0, and a time-varying covariate, Zt, that evolves due to a shock, Q0. (a) Natural representation. (b) Compact representation. Illustrative linear model coefficients are shown as lowercase letters on each edge.

Figure 10: Scenario in which the time-varying covariate Wt’s evolution depends on treatment and an autoregressive process. (a) Natural diagram. (b) Compact representation. Illustrative linear model coefficients are shown as lowercase letters on each edge.

Figure 13: Mean absolute bias for each estimator, averaged across adjustment set categories (i.e., sufficient, insufficient and unclear) and replications in each scenario.
